name: Ananya R.
message: I came in able to open QGIS and not much else. The classification project is the thing I actually show people — it is on my CV with the accuracy numbers attached.

name: Vikram K.
message: Git from week one felt like overkill until the group project. By the end I could branch, review and deploy without anyone holding my hand.

name: Sana M.
message: Most of the course was cleaning messy data, which is exactly what my job turned out to be. The dashboard I built in week seven got me the interview.

name: Pooja D.
message: I was given real tickets on a live project, not a sandbox. My certificate names the project and what I did on it, so I could talk about it properly in interviews.

name: Nikhil J.
message: Flight planning through to a checked orthomosaic in six weeks. The accuracy reporting section is what my employer cared about most.
